extraction.Name: Aaron Moran (deponent); Susan Moran (allottee, deceased)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: It was never mortgaged so far as I know but some of it was sold.
extraction.Buyer: Harry Moran sold for $100, Louise Moran sold for $100.00, Annie Moran sold for $300-$400; Narcise, Jesse, Ellen, Amy, Mable and Susie deeded their share for $1; David Colome inherited Susie's share. Tripp county land: $2700.00 and a Chandler sedan that had been used and valued at perhaps $1000.00 at the time.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Nothing but taxes for all the time the patent has been issued, at least none have been paid so far as I know.
extraction.Gender: Female (Susan Moran, allottee); Male (Aaron Moran, deponent)
extraction.Age: Aaron Moran, age 34 (deponent); Louis Moran, age 84 (heir, in poor health)
extraction.NOTES: Susan Moran is deceased; Aaron Moran is her son and deponent. Estate was probated in state court. Aaron Moran is living on part of the Mellette county land; Louis Moran (husband of Susan Moran, age 84, in poor health) is living on the other part. Heirs who have not sold their interest: Aaron Moran, Louis Moran, Minnie Jacobson, and Lily Colomb. Document notarized by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on June 6, 1929. Document references both Mellette county land and Tripp county land.
